Client Background
Challenge
Objective
Opportunities

Business Outcomes
There was a experience-expectation and value gap between what the
bank thought and what the customers wanted and perceived
Customers expected the program to boost their identity and have
offerings that help them grow their money
Multiple touchpoints failed specifically in service recovery – when the
going was good, it was good. When there is a problem, nobody knows how
to recover.

Experiential segmentation
5 new different experiential segments. These were different than
the 3 functional segments created by the bank. The offerings had
the potential to be positioned according to the experiences they
can lead to, rather than by their features, performance attributes
or functional benefits

delivering growth.
